items.problem: The popup queue says open flows run "one at a time in the order received", but does not set when the next queued open flow starts after the previous one ends: in the same call where that flow ends (before or after `Opened` of its `open_popup` and `UIOpenedEvent`), or in a later frame. Two implementations can differ here. One place shows the difference: back input step 4 (ui-core.md:239) ignores back only "while a popup flow is in progress", and a request waiting in the queue is not a popup flow (ui-core.md:189). So in a gap between two open flows, `is_flow_in_progress` is `true` (ui-core.md:50) while back input goes on to step 5 and closes the topmost open popup. When the next open flow starts in the same call, there is no such gap. Set the start time of the next queued open flow, or make back step 4 also ignore back while a popup request waits in the queue

`open_panels` whose last element has the panel key of the current panel is not settled. Step 3 replaces the current item and step 4 does not push a new item (ui-core.md:163, ui-core.md:164), while `open_panels` pushes the preceding elements "in step 4, before pushing the new item". For stack R, B and `open_panels`(A, B), following the text gives R, B, A, where top item A has no instance and B below it does, which breaks ui-core.md:153. Another implementation gives R, A, B. The tests at ui-core.md:436 and ui-core.md:437 do not cover it. It is reachable through `ShortcutCore` stage 8 with applied stack `Top` (shortcut-core.md:60, and shortcut-core.md:65 applies the replacement rule to those opens)

`reset_panel_stack` during step 5 of a close flow is not settled. The current panel has already received `on_closed(Closed)` and is in its close tween (ui-core.md:176). Flow cancel names only instances not yet shown and a panel in its open tween (ui-core.md:184), and "closes the current panel immediately" is defined at ui-core.md:163 as `on_closed(Closed)` then destroy, so one implementation calls `on_closed` twice and another once. The popup rule sets this case ("calls `on_closed` only on a popup that has not received `on_closed`", ui-core.md:197), and the panel rules have no equivalent. The test at ui-core.md:439 covers only an open flow. It is reachable when a scene transition reaches `reset_panel_stack` (scene-core.md:68) during a close tween

A close flow whose destination prefab is not a panel class has two results. ui-core.md:179 continues with the item below regardless of force, so `close_panel` without force in stack A, X, C shows A and ends with success. The error row at ui-core.md:356, which the test at ui-core.md:440 checks, gives `false` for a prefab root that is not `UIPanel`. When X is the root item with no item below, ui-core.md:180 ends with the stack empty, while ui-core.md:154 says only `reset_panel_stack` removes the root item

The order of `UIClosedEvent` and the after-close callback of `close_popup` is not set. ui-core.md:192 orders hidden callback then after-close callback, and ui-core.md:344 places the event only after the hidden callback. Delivery is synchronous (event-core.md:67), so a subscriber sees the popup's result callback (client-content SKILL.md:143) as already run or not yet run, depending on the implementation. When that callback calls `open_popup` for a popup that opens in the same call, `UIOpenedEvent` of the new popup can also come before `UIClosedEvent` of the old one

A system popup made from the `UICore.systemPopupResource` prefab is settled only for dim. For a `UIPopup` root, no document says whether `accepts_param`, `prepare`, `on_opened`, `on_closed` and its open and close tween presets (ui-core.md:128, ui-core.md:190) apply, although ui-core.md:217 relies on an open tween and ui-core.md:215 says it "opens at once". `accepts_param` defaults to accepting only param none (ui-core.md:141). "popup area" (ui-core.md:221, ui-core.md:464) is defined nowhere, and client-content SKILL.md:162 says the prefab holds no body or buttons because UICore puts them in it, without a defining document saying where. Button placement and open timing of a prefab system popup can therefore differ per implementation

`append_items` and `prepend_items` called while a `set_items` is waiting are not set. ui-core.md:318 sets only a second `set_items`, and the error rows at ui-core.md:370 and ui-core.md:371 name only calls "before `set_items`". Whether such a call fails or applies to the previous item count, and whether the waiting `set_items` then overwrites it, can differ per implementation. It is reachable in chat: content code calls `set_items` for `Reset` and `append_items` for `Appended` (chat-core.md:124), and `set_items` waits for its prefill, so a message can be lost in one implementation and kept in another
